reference.caret_source: AppKit NSTextView.insertionPointColor and CSS AccentColor on macOS 26, verified against live Arc blue caret. No application accent setting was changed.
limits: Little and private selection highlights are not changed or certified.
System accent changes rely on Gecko native system-color invalidation; this test does not change the user preference.
Screenshots are qualitative native checks, not an ICC-calibrated pixel-equality certificate.
reference.rendering_finding: User-origin ::selection declarations compute but are not painted because InitSelectionColorsAndShadow requires author-specified text or background. An author-origin declaration consuming imported Space variables paints correctly.

changes: System accent caret color for macOS command inputs, including Little and private windows.
Author-origin selected-text paint using SemanticColorPalette.subtitle for five imported main Spaces; glyph color is retained.
Configuration validation recognizes font outlines, continuous CALayer masks, Display-P3 tokens and escaped JSON preference strings.
remaining: Little and private selected-text backgrounds remain unchanged pending palette trace.
Caret geometry/blink timing and glyph rasterization are not certified equal.
Main and loaded-Little wide-gamut command rendering remains incomplete.
Strict configuration suite stops at the pre-existing Lua const assignment in config/nvim/lua/config/tips_tmux.lua:366.
No overall Arc speed or full parity claim.
